title: When the Thorn Turns Again
author: Beatrix Yarrow
blurb: Dominic Thackeray, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
